architecture.notes: No BatchNorm; 6 refinement blocks, dilations (1,2,4,8,1,1). Built from src/models/stereonet, unmodified. Param count asserted == 397954 before training; abort otherwise.

budget.compute_note: P2A record 200 epochs in 3829.4 s at BATCH=2 over 160 scenes = 0.1197 s/sample-pass; 13737 train samples -> ~1644 s/epoch -> 20 epochs ~9.1 h compute plus PFM decode overhead. 14 h gate enforced after epoch 1.

data.disparity_reader: src/datasets/pfm.py read_pfm (imported, not copied); values already in pixels, no rescaling
data.holdout: fixed random 5% of triplets, rng seed 0: 723 pretrain-val / 13737 train; forward-only, pretrain-convergence monitoring ONLY, unrelated to frozen KITTI contract
data.loss_valid_mask: gt > 0 AND gt < 184 (P2A representable ceiling; audit measured 0.45% of FT3D above it)
data.note: ARM P on FT3D A+C subset, NOT full SceneFlow. B wholly missing, Monkaa empty. A later FAIL on this subset does not fully discharge the original ARM P; a PASS would.

explicit_diff_vs_phase2_scripts_train_p2.1_dataset: Kitti2015Stereo(hailo_calib, 160 scenes) -> FlyingThings3DTrain(train split, 13737 triplets, scripts/ft3d.py). ONLY permitted difference (i).
explicit_diff_vs_phase2_scripts_train_p2.2_loss_mask_formula: IDENTICAL formula (valid = gt>0 and gt<max_disparity_px with max_disparity_px=184); restated numerically as gt>0 AND gt<184. No change in supervision semantics.
explicit_diff_vs_phase2_scripts_train_p2.3_epochs: 200 -> 20; CosineAnnealingLR T_max follows EPOCHS (20). ONLY permitted difference (iii).
explicit_diff_vs_phase2_scripts_train_p2.4_validation_monitor: P2A: first 10 hailo_val scenes every 5 epochs -> Stage 1: first 10 pretrain-val FT3D triplets EVERY epoch (brief requires per-epoch pretrain-val EPE in the log; full-resolution forward, no scaling; valid = gt>0 & gt<184). Monitoring-only; no KITTI data anywhere.
explicit_diff_vs_phase2_scripts_train_p2.5_checkpoint_names: p2a_best.pth/p2a_final.pth -> checkpoints/armp_stage1_best.pth/checkpoints/armp_stage1_final.pth; contract verification appended (strict load into fresh P2A model).
explicit_diff_vs_phase2_scripts_train_p2.everything_else: UNCHANGED: optimizer Adam betas=(0.9,0.999), LR=1e-3, masked smooth L1 beta=1.0, batch 2, crop 256x512, scale aug s~logUniform(0.7,1.7) w=round(512/s) h=round(256/s) BILINEAR images / NEAREST disparity realised sx=512/w, op order crop->resize->ImageNet normalise->gain jitter sigma=0.1, no flip, fp32, seed 0, shuffle with seeded generator, num_workers=0.

recipe_mirror.augmentation: scale-augmented random crop + independent per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1; no horizontal flip
recipe_mirror.op_order: crop -> resize -> ImageNet normalise -> gain jitter
recipe_mirror.window: w = round(512/s), h = round(256/s), uniform top-left

stage: ARM P STAGE 1 of 2: PRETRAIN ONLY (FT3D A+C subset, NOT full SceneFlow). NO fine-tuning. NO KITTI training. NO hailo_val evaluation.
